title: iOS tap fails at 90 s and session start fails too — leftover driver or load
symptom: tap_failed repeats with 'maestro 응답 없음 (90초)' (maestro unresponsive, 90 s), and app session start, as advised, fails with 'tools/call timed out after 120s'
cause: An xcodebuild (maestro-driver-ios-config.xctestrun) or maestro JVM left by an earlier run is still alive, or host load is high, so the driver cannot start. Starting a session does not fix this
fix: Check load with uptime (2x the core count or more means overload)
In ps, check that maestro-driver-ios-config · maestro/lib are not owned by a pro-launch session
Kill only the leftovers: pkill -f maestro-driver-ios-config; pkill -f maestro/lib, then confirm with launch_cli.py app tree
If load is high, retry with MAESTRO_DRIVER_STARTUP_TIMEOUT=180000 (iOS driver not ready in time)
